design_condition: Two new buildings are precisely arranged around the existing school to mediate between buildings, accommodate the slope, and create clearly assigned outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The precise arrangement creates a new whole that integrates easily into the heterogeneous context.
The differentiated entrances generate a sequence of clearly assigned outdoor spaces.
The dispersed spatial programme produces an exciting access system that separates and reconnects the uses.
Keeping all rooms on one floor provides short distances, clarity, and a tangible school community.
The kindergarten arrangement benefits from multi-sided orientation and a visual connection to the outside.
The multi-purpose building impresses from a functional point of view, with a spacious foyer and well-organized delivery.
The reserved appearance and limited design elements create a unified whole related to the existing building.
The simply structured buildings are expected to provide good profitability.

negative.statement: Locating most of the break area across the street is viewed critically.
The kindergarten outdoor area seems too tight, with its use and design largely unspecified.
The access halls lack an outside connection and are not very suitable as learning zones.
The kindergarten skylights are questioned because of their small dimensions and the two-story structure.
The foyer arrangement is unsuitable as a school gymnasium because front glazing impairs sports operation.
The great depth of the school building is not managed convincingly.
Deficient lighting in the kindergartens and corridors, together with introverted break halls, reveals weaknesses in the concept.
